data.name: Kamunari's Claw
data.description:
Kamunari's Claw is a legendary bow forged in the now-ruined village of Samui, known for its unparalleled craftsmanship and mastery over elemental forces. The bow is a relic of a bygone era when Samui was revered for producing shinobi with extraordinary skill in the art of archery and wind manipulation. The weapon is named after Kamunari, whose presence was said to be invoked during the bow's creation.


The bow is crafted from a rare wood found only in the highest peaks of the Hyuogaan Mountains, making it both incredibly durable and flexible. The bowstring is woven from the hair of mythical creatures known for their speed and strength, giving the bow an unmatched draw strength and accuracy. When drawn, the bow channels the power of the wind, forming arrows from the very air around it.

data.name: Killer Clown Riddle 1
data.description: ”I sob where roots and rivers meet, Where Konoki’s breath makes nature sweet. The leaves are near, their whispers kind, But sorrow flows through water’s mind. A quiet spot—unseen, confined— Find me where nine times three and a pair combined."

data.name: Killer Clown Riddle 2
data.description: ”Surrounded tight by blades and spies, I cackle loud where danger lies. Glacier chills me, Current stings— Yet chaos hides between their wings. The Shroud can’t see, Tsukimori dreams— My stage is water, chaos streams. My number? A riddle’s flow: Two-thirty—just so you know."

data.name: Killer Clown Riddle 3
data.description: “The sun spits fire on lands I tread, Where scorpions feast and skies burn red. Each breath a curse, each step a fight, I blaze through dunes from left to right. My fury falls in perfect line— A count that climbs by one's design."

data.name: Kitsune Armor
data.description: Crafted by Shiro during his early years as an apprentice, the Kitsune Armor serves as a vibrant tribute to his rising genius and sharp eye for aesthetics. Its iconic purple and white plates mirror the elegance of the legendary fox spirits, blending high-end protection with a stylish design that remains a sought-after relic among veteran warriors.

data.name: Kitsune Belt
data.description: Shiro designed this centerpiece to act as a metaphysical vacuum; when a foe strikes, the gold fox's eyes flare, allowing the belt to swallow the essence of their techniques and weave that stolen power into the wearer's next strike.

data.name: Kitsune Gauntlets
data.description: Shiro painstakingly reinforced these bracers with Fox-Fire silk, allowing the stylish white-lacquered plates to ripple with a faint purple hum whenever the wearer weaves hand signs. They are exceptionally light, designed to mimic the swift, unpredictable paw-strikes of a kitsune in the heat of a duel.

effects.description: Decreases cooldown of Clear and Cleanse

data.name: Kitsune Mask
data.description: Forged from the calcified spirit-mask of an ancient kitsune, this helm is the centerpiece of the set and the only piece to retain the fox’s original, piercing golden eyes. Shiro left the natural ivory finish untouched, carving only subtle grooves to let the wearer’s chakra vent as a ghostly purple mist, striking terror into any foe who meets its frozen, predatory grin.

data.name: Kitsune Pants
data.description: Based on the Kitsune design series, Belt

data.name: Kitsune Pants-F
data.description: Shiro designed the wide cut specifically to conceal the wearer's footwork, granting a tactical advantage that mirrors the fox spirit's deceptive nature.

data.name: Kitsune Tabi-Shoes
data.description: These specialized shoes are fitted with silent-step soles made from enchanted fox-hide, ensuring that not even a dry leaf crunches beneath the wearer's weight. The striking purple accents and white bindings provide a snug fit, engineered by a young Shiro to allow for gravity-defying leaps across the forest canopy.

data.name: Konoki's ANBU mask
data.description: This ancient ANBU mask from Konoki is a relic of a bygone era, carrying with it the silent echoes of countless covert missions and untold stories. The mask is crafted from a durable yet lightweight material, designed to offer both protection and anonymity to its wearer. Its surface is smooth, but time has left faint cracks and weathering, giving it a worn, battle-hardened appearance.  This ANBU mask is not just a piece of armor; it is a symbol of duty, sacrifice, and the hidden strength of Konoki’s elite.
